sources.location: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC7442833/fullTextXML (Sabino et al., Cell Death Dis 2020, PMID 32826880)

claims.evidence: Only RAW file in the deposit; all 10 TMT channels are rows of this one file.
Fig. 6a maps 126-127C control, 128N-129N zyxin 1-572, 129C-130C zyxin 277-572, 131 pooled reference; PD quantification method TMT 10plex with channels 126..131 confirms plex.
Triplicate transfections per condition; 'pooled reference' normalisation channel. Source names are our labels. Pool composition not stated; pooled sample column set to pooled.
HeLa transfected with pFLAG CMV encoding full-length zyxin, zyxin 277-572, or mock. Free-text values do not resolve in NCIT/EFO (validator warning).

claims.value: HeLa; CVCL_0030; age 30Y6M; female; cervical carcinoma; epithelial cell
claims.evidence: Paper names HeLa cells; age/sex/disease/cell type come from Cellosaurus, not the deposit.
Reconcile flagged tissue claims on cell-line runs as a blocker; sentinel used. PRIDE organismPart is 'Cell culture'. Cellosaurus origin (cervix) is carried by the cell line columns.
Protocol and paper say Q Exactive; PD WorkflowInputFiles instrument field 'Q Exactive Orbitrap'.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; TMT6plex Any N-term and K fixed; Acetyl Any N-term, Gln->pyro-Glu Q Any N-term, Oxidation M, Deamidated N variable
claims.evidence: Read from PD Sequest HT node in the pepXML header. Paper prose says deamidation (NQ) but the node lists only N; deposited node followed. Static label named TMT6plex in the search (same mass as TMT10plex).
Sequest HT node and protocol text.
Reporter Ions Quantifier node: MS2 activation type HCD; pepXML activation_method HCD.
Paper methods: reduced with 3.5 mM TCEP, alkylated with 5 mM chloroacetamide (lysis described for fibroblasts and HeLa cells in a shared sentence).

limitations: Channel map taken from a figure image (Fig. 6a); no deposited text map and the PD study sample names are default channel names.
Pooled reference composition not described in the paper.
Age, sex, disease, cell type from Cellosaurus, not the deposit.
Collision energy (28 in the file name) not stated in text; omitted. Passage number, culture medium, storage temperature not stated.
Treatment values are free text and give OLS warnings in ncit/efo.
Supplementary tables S1/S2 not read; no sample-level metadata expected there.
The pdResult was read only by HTTP range requests of selected SQLite pages; the RAW file header was not read (instrument from PD WorkflowInputFiles).
